paragraphs.text: Zenon was one of Kytheon Iora 's irregulars on the plane of Theros . He was a Setessan and wore a green cloak.

As a teenager, Zenon was later part of the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses . He was killed along with the other irregulars when Heliod 's spear thrown by Kytheon was returned by Erebos .
